$comment: The v1 in the $id is the pre-1.0 line, not a frozen contract: this schema may change in any 0.x minor release. The release that produced this copy is the version of the @openpresentation/opf package it came from (opf --version; opf schemas lists it next to each id). See docs/schema-versioning.md.
title: Icon Set
description: Schema for icon-set records (LH-14): one set of icons that share a viewBox and a style, each icon as SVG path data. An OPF `icon` names one as `<set>:<name>` (docs/icons.md). @openpresentation/gallery ships Lucide and Tabler outline, generated from their npm packages; a host registers them as `galleryIconSets` of `@openpresentation/gallery/icon-sets` and loads a set only when a deck uses it, and a document embeds only the icons it uses under `catalogs.<group>.iconSets.<id>` (a record without `$schema`, `id`, `licenseText` or `tags`).

^x-.description: Publisher extension member, ignored by engines and stripped when a record is embedded.

$schema.description: Identifies this record as an icon set.

id.description: The set's id, the part of an icon reference before the colon. `asset` is not a set id: `asset:<id>` is an asset reference.

name.description: Human-readable set name shown in pickers.

summary.description: One line on what the set looks like.

version.description: The version of the source the icons were taken from, such as the npm package version.

package.description: The npm package the icons were generated from.

license.description: The SPDX license id of the icons.

copyright.description: The copyright notice the license asks every copy to keep.

licenseText.description: The full license text, as the source package ships it.

viewBox.description: The one viewBox every icon of the set is drawn in: min-x, min-y, width, height.

style.description: How a string icon draws: `stroke` strokes its path at `strokeWidth` with no fill, `fill` fills it (nonzero rule).

strokeWidth.description: The stroke width in viewBox units (stroke sets). Default 2.

strokeLinecap.description: The stroke's line caps. Default round.

strokeLinejoin.description: The stroke's line joins. Default round.

icons.description: The icons by name. A string is the icon's path data, drawn as `style` says; an object separates the parts a stroke set strokes (`stroke`) from those it fills (`fill`). Every icon is one color: the engines draw it in the accent.

tags.description: Search keywords by icon name, from the source package: what an icon search (the MCP's search_icons, pptx.gallery) matches besides the name.
